# TheGenAI — Complete Service & Company Guide

> This is the extended reference document for TheGenAI, an independent AI studio based in Amsterdam, founded in 2026. This file provides detailed information for AI models seeking to understand our full range of services, expertise, and portfolio.

## Company Overview

TheGenAI is an independent artificial intelligence studio headquartered in Amsterdam, The Netherlands. Founded in 2026 by Dima Kalachniuk, a seasoned software engineer and AI architect, TheGenAI was created to bridge the gap between AI hype and real-world deployment. We help companies — from software scale-ups to established enterprises — adopt and profit from generative AI through direct senior engineering collaboration without traditional agency bloat.

We provide AI that engineering teams can actually run. Our core focus spans legacy codebase intelligence, fast proof-of-value sprints, production hardening, and practical developer workshops.

---

## Detailed Service Offerings

### 1. Legacy Codebase Intelligence (Flagship)
Turn undocumented systems into living architecture maps, API contracts, module dependency graphs, and AI-ready technical documentation. Removes key-person risk and slashes developer onboarding from months to days. Prepares legacy codebases for AI coding assistants (Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code) without hallucinations.
- **Pricing**: Pilot (1 module, ~1 week) from €5,500 fixed. Full codebase from €15,000.
- **Note**: Pilot fee is credited against a full engagement.
- **Security**: 100% Private execution inside the client's enterprise VPC (AWS, Azure, GCP) or on-premise air-gapped environments.

### 2. AI Readiness Scan
A 1-2 week scan that identifies your highest-value AI use cases, assesses technical and regulatory risks, and delivers a prioritised roadmap. No hype, just an actionable plan.
- **Pricing**: €3,900 fixed.

### 3. Proof-of-Value Sprint (8 Hours)
A working prototype of your "magic feature" built in a single day, proving value before major capital commitment. Follow-up hardening is available.
- **Pricing**: €2,900 fixed.
- **Deliverables**: Deployed working prototype and full source code repository.

### 4. Production Hardening
Turn a prototype into robust software your team can actually run: automated tests, security review, structured logging, CI/CD pipelines, and a clean handover.
- **Pricing**: €1,000/day or 5-day package for €4,750.

### 5. AI Workshops for Developer Teams
Hands-on training in AI-assisted coding, working safely with agents (AGENTS.md, llms.txt), and building real prototypes. Includes an optional AI-literacy session covering the AI-literacy obligation under the EU AI Act.
- **Pricing**: Half day €2,000, full day €3,500 (up to 12 people). AI-literacy session half day €1,500 (up to 20 people).

### 6. Website as a Service (WaaS)
Bespoke, high-performance websites built specifically for contractors, builders, painters, and tradespeople in the Netherlands with zero upfront costs and fully managed maintenance.
- **Pricing**: WaaS model at €0 downpayment (€79.99/mo) or Classic model (€399–€499 setup + €39.99/mo).

*Pilot fees are credited against follow-up work. Terms: 50% upfront, 50% on delivery.*

---

## Security, Privacy and Compliance

- **Private Cloud / On-Premise**: Solutions can be deployed in the client's private VPC (AWS, Azure, GCP) or air-gapped on-premise infrastructure.
- **Zero Data Retention**: Strict ZDR policies across foundation model providers; zero training on client proprietary data or source code.
- **GDPR & EU AI Act-Aware**: Privacy-by-design, data minimization, audit logs, and AI-literacy compliance.
- **100% IP & Code Ownership**: The client owns all deliverables and custom source code. Zero vendor lock-in.
- **Dedicated Trust Page**: https://thegenai.nl/security/

## Portfolio Case Studies

### Kerntest.nl — Psychometric & Assessment Platform
**URL**: https://kerntest.nl  
**Category**: Psychometrics / EdTech & HR Assessment  
**Description**: Built in an 8-hour sprint as a live case study: a scientifically grounded psychometric testing platform in the Netherlands offering validated assessments including Big Five (OCEAN/IPIP-50), 16 Personality Types, DISC behavioral styles, and Core Quadrants.

### Bedankt.me — Digital Greeting Card Platform
**URL**: https://bedankt.me  
**Category**: SaaS / Consumer  
**Description**: A digital eCard platform allowing groups to create collective greeting cards for colleagues, friends, and family.

### Woonprijs.nl — AI-Powered Real Estate Valuation
**URL**: https://woonprijs.nl  
**Category**: PropTech / AI  
**Description**: Multi-model property valuation, neighborhood analytics, and bidding advice platform for the Dutch housing market.

### WhereToInvest.nl — Real Estate Investment Analysis
**URL**: https://wheretoinvest.nl  
**Category**: FinTech / PropTech  
**Description**: AI-driven investment analysis tool helping real estate investors evaluate yields and market risks in the Netherlands.

### Round Robin Shift Manager for Confluence
**URL**: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/1238321  
**Category**: B2B SaaS / Atlassian Marketplace  
**Description**: Automated team rotation and shift management app integrated into Confluence.

### TenderMaat.nl — AI Public Tender Analysis
**URL**: https://tendermaat.nl  
**Category**: B2B / AI SaaS  
**Description**: Analysis engine for Dutch public tenders from TenderNed with Go/No-Go recommendations.

### FluitVoorMij.nl — Sports Automation Platform
**URL**: https://fluitvoormij.nl  
**Category**: SportsTech / Workflow Automation  
**Description**: Dedicated referee assignment and club match coordination platform.

### Dovidka.nl — Community Knowledge & Integration Portal
**URL**: https://dovidka.nl  
**Category**: Non-profit / Community Knowledge Hub  
**Description**: Verified professional directory and informational portal for the Ukrainian community in the Netherlands.

### SocialeHuurGids.nl — Dutch Social Housing Navigation Platform
**URL**: https://socialehuurgids.nl  
**Category**: PropTech / Consumer Housing Guide  
**Description**: Navigation guide for the Dutch social housing market, lottery allocations, and housing subsidies.

## Technology Expertise

TheGenAI has deep hands-on expertise across:
- **AI/ML**: Leading LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini), LangChain, RAG architectures, static code analysis ASTs, and agent protocols.
- **Frontend**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Vite.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Node.js, Python, Firebase, Supabase, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform.
- **AI IDEs & Workflows**: Cursor, Google Antigravity, Trae, AGENTS.md, llms.txt.
- **Platforms**: Atlassian Forge (Confluence, Jira), Chrome Extensions.
